name: Which type of washing machine is best for an accessible laundry room?

mainEntity.name: Which type of washing machine is best for an accessible laundry room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Front-loading washing machines and dryers are generally considered best for accessible laundry rooms. Their design allows for easier loading and unloading from a wheelchair or a seated position, eliminating the need to bend over a top-loader. Pedestals can also be used to raise front-loading machines to a more comfortable height. Look for models with accessible controls, such as large buttons, digital displays, and audible feedback.
acceptedAnswer.description: Front-loading washers and dryers are typically best, allowing easier access from a seated position, especially when paired with pedestals.
